snippet.title: Senior Safety Advice
snippet.description:
Welcome to the YouTube channel of Certified Senior Home Safety Specialists, Esther Kane and Robin Schiltz. 

Together, we have more than three decades of combined experience in healthcare (Esther as an Occupational Therapist and Robin as a senior care Dental Hygienist) and as caretakers of our own elderly parents. 

This channel is for seniors and caregivers of elderly parents and senior loved ones.

Visit our website at https://seniorsafetyadvice.com for in-depth articles to help you and the senior loved ones in your life. 

Some of the key topics that Senior Safety Advice covers include: 
• senior life hacks and demos 
• reviews of products for seniors 
• safety tips for aging in place 
• home modifications to increase safety 
• helping seniors navigate technology 
• other useful information for seniors and caregivers 

NEW content uploaded twice a month! Thanks for visiting, sharing, and subscribing!

snippet.title: Anik Singal
snippet.description:
In May 2022, everything changed.

I was about to sell my 9-figure company. Retire. Focus on my kids.
Then the FTC showed up.

18 months. $15M gone.
A brutal lawsuit that almost ended everything.

But I didn’t quit.

I fought back—and built something better!
 
A first-of-its-kind AI-powered software that helps marketing and sales teams automatically audit and monitor their advertising for compliance.

And guess what? It’s working.

Because of the FTC, I stumbled onto something incredible—a solution that could protect thousands of businesses from the same challenges I faced.

📈 What I Do Now

Today, through my new holding company Ugentic AI, I invest in and partner with AI & Martech SaaS companies, using the same growth strategies that helped scale my past businesses.

💰 If you own an innovative AI or Martech SaaS company with a fully built-out product and are looking for an investor who can help you scale faster—let’s talk.

snippet.title: AI for Us 50 Plus
snippet.description:
AI Made Simple for Life After 50
Practical, human-centered AI for curious adults

We’re Tom and Angela Hathaway, and we help adults 50+ understand and use artificial intelligence with confidence, clarity, and common sense. With decades of experience training, mentoring, and coaching thousands of people worldwide, we’ve always believed that complex ideas should be approachable, practical, and even enjoyable. That hasn’t changed—only the tools have.

On this channel, we break down generative AI in plain English for people who didn’t grow up with it but want to understand what it means for their lives now.

You’ll learn how to:
-  Use AI tools to simplify everyday tasks
-  Boost creativity, productivity, and problem-solving
-  Better understand how AI is shaping work, communication, and society
-   Stay informed and capable in a rapidly changing world—without feeling overwhelmed

If you’re over 50 and want AI to work for you, you’re in the right place.
 
Welcome to AI for Us - 50+

Welcome to AI Mastermind with Tony DeSimone. After decades teaching and working with leaders, I've learned: powerful tech is useless if people can't apply it effectively.
ChatGPT and AI aren't trends—they're tools defining how we work and solve problems. Most training focuses on features, not practical use, leaving people confused.
This channel delivers proven strategies in plain terms. My teaching background breaks complex AI into steps that work for CEOs, managers, educators, and professionals. Every use case is tested in real scenarios.
AI literacy is becoming essential like computer skills twenty years ago. Those mastering these tools gain career advantages. Those waiting scramble to catch up.
Whether leading teams or accelerating growth, this provides direct AI mastery. No jargon—just clear, actionable strategies with measurable results.
Your advantage depends on quickly harnessing AI to amplify capabilities.

snippet.title: Senior Power Community
snippet.description:
Senior Power Community helps seniors, spouses, adult children, caregivers, and family supporters make better decisions in a world that has become more complicated, more expensive, and more confusing.
Our focus is practical: independence, safety, health, money, mobility, technology, family life, caregiving, fraud prevention, medical bills, car buying, Medicare confusion, rehab and skilled nursing decisions, AI tools, and everyday situations where seniors may feel rushed, pressured, or overwhelmed.
Our guiding principle is:
**Information + Knowledge = Senior Power**
Senior Power Community was created to help seniors and families slow things down before they sign, pay, agree, respond, or panic.
We produce videos, podcasts, tutorials, workbooks, checklists, scripts, decision tools, and practical guides designed to help viewers ask better questions, organize facts, recognize warning signs, compare options, and prepare for important conversations.

snippet.title: Kathy Gets It Together
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Kathy. I’m 55 and I started learning AI completely by accident.
Now I’m documenting what it looks like to learn new things later in life, build a YouTube channel from scratch, and figure things out in real time.
On this channel you’ll see:
• how I use AI tools like ChatGPT
• what it’s like learning tech after 50
• honest midlife realizations
• starting over and staying curious
• creative experiments (and occasional chaos)
I didn’t grow up with technology.
I didn’t go to college.
And not long ago I was afraid to even update my iPhone.
But I’m discovering something surprising:
You’re not too late to learn something new.
You’re not too old to create.
And curiosity might be the best skill we have.
If you’ve ever felt behind in life, overwhelmed by technology, or like you missed your chance — you’re in the right place.
New videos about learning, reinvention, and figuring things out one imperfect step at a time.
Stick around. Things are just getting interesting.


#MidlifeLearning

snippet.title: The Tina Lorenz
snippet.description:
⬇️ 𝐉𝐎𝐈𝐍 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝟓-𝐃𝐀𝐘 𝐅𝐈𝐍𝐃𝐀𝐁𝐈𝐋𝐈𝐓𝐘 𝐂𝐇𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐄𝐍𝐆𝐄 ⬇️
Your expertise should be easier to find, understand, and recommend.

I’m Tina Lorenz. For more than 21 years, I’ve helped people turn what they know into words, visibility, authority, and income.

Now I help experienced experts become more findable by humans, search, and AI.
Through what I call The Iron Triangle of Findability, you’ll learn how to:

💥 Get Found
💥 Get Recognized
💥 Get Recommended

On this channel, I share practical ways to use YouTube, LinkedIn, your website, copywriting, and AI to build a clear body of work that shows people what you know and why it matters.

This is exactly how you get found online after 50!

You’ll also hear about the inner work behind being seen, claiming your expertise, and staying visible long enough to be remembered.

I started my own online career after 50. So yes, experience matters.

But experience has to be made visible.

That’s what we do here.

snippet.title: AI Tool Journey
snippet.description:
Welcome to AI Tool Journey! Your gateway to the exciting world of artificial intelligence tools. 
 
Our mission is to help anyone interested in AI not only learn how to use it, but also find the right tools that fit their needs. 
 
We start with popular chatbots like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek then dive into a wide range of AI-powered tools for text generation, image creation, video editing, music composition, programming assistance, productivity enhancement, and specialized professional applications. 
 
Our tutorials are designed for a broad audience - from curious beginners and students, to researchers, content creators, developers, and professionals across industries - all looking to understand and use AI effectively. 
 
Subscribe and join us on this journey to stay updated on the latest AI trends, tools, and how to actually use them in real life. 
 
#AI #AITools #AILearning #AITutorial #TechTutorial #Innovation #Learning
